C1.name: linear advection L2 error converges at h**(p+1), p = 1,2,3
C1.criterion: least-squares observed order on (8,16,32) cells within 15 % of p+1

C1b.name: 2D tensor-product advection L2 error converges at h**(p+1)
C1b.criterion: least-squares observed order on (8,16,32)^2 cells within 15 % of p+1

C2.name: heat equation L2 error converges at h**(p+1), p = 1,2,3
C2.criterion: least-squares observed order on (4,8,16) cells within 15 % of p+1

C3.name: Sod shock position to 2 % of a cell; Gibbs amplitude decreases with p
C3.criterion: |x_num - x_exact| <= 0.02 dx against the exact Riemann solution (shock located by sub-cell profile matching); unlimited overshoot amplitude non-increasing in p

C4.name: hp convergence: h-rate == p+1 and p-refinement == analytic projection floor
C4.criterion: observed h-order within 15 % of p+1 for every p; e(p)/e(p+1) within 15 % of the sharp L2-projection ratio at fixed h (ncells >= 8)

C5.name: negative control: no limiter => non-physical oscillation at the shock
C5.criterion: unlimited Gibbs amplitude >= 0.1 % of the density jump, strictly larger than the TVB-limited amplitude, and total variation above the exact one

C6.name: every criterion is pytest-gated and serialised with its thresholds
C6.criterion: C1,C1b,C2,C3,C4,C5 serialised with measured values and thresholds; tests/test_verification_ladder.py exists and collects >= 6 tests; gates_verified.json present on disk
